theorems.name: Submission.cmc_tendsto_integral_of_limsup_liminf
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → G ⊆ U → μ G ≤ liminf (fun j => μs j G) atTop) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
